feature: Pull to refresh the Chat and Stories lists
notes: at the top of either list drag down: the list follows with rubber-band resistance (never past 160px) and Puff rises from behind its edge stretching a little; happy eyes then wide ones past 72px; let go there and state.refresh() reloads the list while Puff bobs and his trail puffs pulse (400ms at least) then he drifts off up and right as the list settles; let go sooner (or the pointer is cancelled) and it springs back; only engages at scrollTop 0 and only downward (on touch a drag down at the top is kept from the browser; a drag up still scrolls); the click on letting go is swallowed so a row is not also opened; a status line says Refreshing and then All up to date (or Couldn't refresh); reduced motion: no rise; stretch; bob or drift (Puff fades in and out); no button of its own since both lists already update live
